step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram shows Datadog's Kubernetes scaling model on AWS. At the top level, a Meta Cluster running on EC2 manages individual Kubernetes (K8s) cluster control planes (also running on EC2). Each K8s cluster includes Elastic Load Balancing (ELB) nodes below a dashed line boundary, distributing incoming application traffic to underlying worker node groups running on EC2 instances (App 1, App 2, and Cluster 2 worker nodes).

graph.name: Datadog Meta Cluster Kubernetes Architecture
graph.notes: Datadog uses an EC2-based Meta Cluster to manage and scale multiple individual Kubernetes cluster control planes and their corresponding ELBs and EC2 node groups.
